stories.title: Ministro diz que resultado do primeiro turno não afeta votação do fim da 6x1, que continua prioritária

en.title: Minister says first round result does not affect vote on ending 6x1 work week, which remains a priority
en.summary: Brazil's minister of institutional relations stated that unfavorable first-round election results for President Lula will not impact the Senate vote on a constitutional amendment to eliminate the 6x1 work schedule, which remains a government priority for this week.

stories.title: Transmaas integra inteligência artificial à operação

en.title: Transmaas integrates artificial intelligence into operations
en.summary: A Brazilian international logistics company operating in Mercosul corridors is implementing artificial intelligence tools to improve vehicle scheduling, information management, fleet monitoring, and documentary processes across operations in multiple South American countries.

stories.title: Blumenau Iluminação projeta receita acima de R$ 500 milhões em 2026

en.title: Blumenau Iluminação projects revenue above 500 million reais in 2026
en.summary: A Brazilian lighting solutions company achieved 400 million reais in revenue in 2025 and projects exceeding 500 million reais in 2026, with plans to expand into the European market through a commercial representation in Portugal.

stories.title: Com reeleição improvável, Alcolumbre retoma análise da PEC da 6x1 nesta semana

en.title: With reelection unlikely, Alcolumbre resumes analysis of 6x1 PEC this week
en.summary: Far-right election gains have severely diminished reelection prospects for Brazil's Senate and Chamber presidents, though they are resuming the constitutional amendment vote eliminating the 6x1 work week this week.

stories.title: Cunhado de Vorcaro relatou dor de barriga diante de cobranças para fazer repasses ao filme 'Dark Horse'

en.title: Vorcaro's brother-in-law reported stomach pain amid demands to make transfers for 'Dark Horse' film
en.summary: Federal Police messages from ex-banker Daniel Vorcaro's phone show he and associates took over a month to transfer funds to a U.S. fund allegedly financing the film "Dark Horse" at senator Flávio Bolsonaro's request. Vorcaro's brother-in-law reported difficulties with the transaction and physical discomfort from the pressure.
